paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentence counts across different dataset domains (categories). The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains labeled “Categories,” shown in the order Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs (with the category labels rotated diagonally), and the vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sentences (K),” using a linear scale with tick labels shown from 0 up to at least 800 in regular increments of 200. Each category is represented by a single solid light pink/salmon vertical bar with a dark blue numeric annotation above it indicating the bar value: Administrative is approximately 525K, Religion 50K, Non-fiction 190K, Fiction 35K, Law 23K, News 902K, Science 110K, and Blogs 2K. The tallest bar is News (902K) and the shortest is Blogs (2K), and there is no visible grouping, stacking, legend, or special emphasis beyond the numeric value labels placed above each bar.
